description: LCL with piece dimensions and a stated total weight (the commonest real phrasing, spec §17.1).

input.subject: LCL quote Shanghai to Rotterdam
input.body:
Hi,

We need an LCL quote Shanghai to Rotterdam port to port: 3 pallets, each 120 x 80 x 150 cm, total weight 1,200 kg. General cargo (furniture parts), not hazardous.

Thanks,
Sam

expected.notes: 3 x 1.2 x 0.8 x 1.5 = 4.32 m³ derived from pieces; 1,200 kg stated. W/M = max(1.2 t, 4.32 m³) = 4.32.
